title: Amazon Kinesis to AWS Lambda using REST API
description: REST API that executes a PutRecords API call to a Kinesis Data stream. The stream is then consumed by a Lambda function.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern will deploy a Amazon API Gateway endpoint that integrates with Amazon Kinesis. The records from the Kinesis stream are processed by a Lambda function.
